learning_objective: 🎯 Discover how the ancient magic of Yoga harmonizes your body, breath, and mind to build ultimate flexibility and inner peace!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Asanas are special physical postures that safely stretch and strengthen your muscles. Holding these poses regularly improves your flexibility, gives you amazing balance, and fixes your daily posture.
Pranayama is the super science of breath control. Learning to breathe deeply and rhythmically fills your brain with fresh oxygen and instantly calms your nerves before a big test or sports match!
Yoga is not just an exercise; it is a way to quiet your busy mind. A few minutes of quiet meditation helps you focus better in school and feel super positive all day long.

fun_activity.title: 🏆 The Digroz Tree Pose Test
fun_activity.instructions: Stand tall, place the sole of one foot on your opposite inner thigh, and bring your hands to a prayer position near your chest. Stare at a fixed point and hold the 'Vrikshasana' (Tree Pose) for 30 seconds without wobbling!

quick_recap: ⭐ Asanas build a strong, flexible body and help maintain a healthy, upright posture.
⭐ Pranayama teaches you how to control your breathing to manage stress and boost energy.
⭐ Regular Yoga practice beautifully connects your mind, body, and spirit for total well-being.
